The '''3rd Imperial Heavy Armor''' was an [[Assault Armor Division/Legends|armored division]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] that fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="VOTF" />
